column1: The convoy ahead carries food, medicine, and people who trusted our promise. Beyond these dunes, Meridian has gone silent. We will not leave them waiting.
column2: 前方车队载着粮食、药品，以及相信我们承诺的人。沙丘另一侧，子午城已陷入沉默。我们不能让他们空等。

column1: Escort the relief vehicles along the marked road. Clear each ambush before the drivers advance, and keep repair crews close enough to reach damaged armor.
column2: 沿标记道路护送救援车辆。让司机前进前先清除伏击，并让维修组始终能够接近受损装甲。

column1: Do not scatter at the first contact. Tanks hold the approach while infantry sweep the shoulders. Every surviving truck gives the next settlement another chance.
column2: 不要在首次接敌时分散。坦克控制通路，步兵清扫路肩。每辆幸存卡车，都能给下一个聚落带去希望。

column1: I am coming with you. Bring our command team home with at least half its strength intact, and the archive will record a preservation commendation.
column2: 我会与你们同行。让指挥组以至少一半战力安全归来，档案将记录一枚保全嘉奖。

column1: Recruits are watching how we answer this signal. Helix has cut the logistics relay, but a broken network is something disciplined soldiers can put right.
column2: 新兵都在看我们如何回应这个信号。螺旋切断了后勤中继，但纪律严明的士兵能够重新接通网络。

column1: Establish a command lab, assign a tank to guard the approach, then send infantry to capture the relay. Hold it through the warned enemy responses.
column2: 建立指挥实验室，命令坦克警戒通路，再派步兵夺取中继站。顶住预警的敌军反扑，守住阵地。

column1: Guard keeps armor where the infantry need it. Follow keeps support beside that armor. Practice both deliberately; a formation only works when its jobs agree.
column2: 警戒让装甲留在步兵需要的位置；跟随让支援紧伴装甲。认真练习两者，分工一致，编队才有意义。

column1: Keep the commander out of the first volley. Finish with at least half the hero hull intact to earn the operation preservation commendation for our archive.
column2: 别让指挥官承受第一轮齐射。胜利时保住英雄至少一半耐久，即可在档案中获得本次行动的保全嘉奖。

column1: These mountain relays carry the last trace of my brother. Helix is erasing the channel one station at a time. We need two working fronts.
column2: 这些山地中继站保存着我弟弟最后的痕迹。螺旋正逐站抹除频道。我们必须同时维持两条战线。

column1: Capture any two relays with infantry and hold them uncontested. The required time accumulates, so regroup when necessary instead of spending lives defending every meter.
column2: 用步兵夺取任意两座中继站，并保持无人争夺。控制时间可以累积，必要时重新集结，不必为每一米土地牺牲。

column1: Split armor and repair support into separate assignments. Watch the northeast and southeast approaches after the first capture; their responses are finite, and ours must endure.
column2: 将装甲与维修支援分到不同任务。首次夺取后留意东北和东南通路；敌军反扑有限，而我们必须坚持。

column1: Recover the signal without breaking the command team. Victory with the hero above half hull earns a preservation commendation; keeping all three relays also aids Cinder Ford.
column2: 找回信号，也要保全指挥组。英雄耐久高于一半时获胜，可获得保全嘉奖；控制全部三站还能支援烬河渡口。

column1: The river guns can stop the convoy, but the wrecks below are still transmitting civilian calls. Voss is going down there. We will cover him.
column2: 河岸炮阵能够阻止车队，但下方残骸仍在发送平民呼救。沃斯要下去搜索，我们必须掩护他。

column1: Secure the western fire-control post, disable the convoy command vehicle, and hold the ford while the search proceeds. The marked crossings are your ground approaches.
column2: 夺取西岸火控站，击毁车队指挥车，在搜索期间守住渡口。标记的浅滩就是地面部队的进攻路线。

column1: Do not chase through the barrage. Keep repair support behind the river guns, screen the banks with infantry, and escort every recovered survivor to the aid station.
column2: 不要追进炮火。让维修支援留在河炮后方，用步兵保护两岸，并护送每一位获救者前往救护站。

column1: A successful rescue strengthens the next operation. Preserve at least half of the hero hull at victory as well, and the archive records your command commendation.
column2: 成功救援将支援下一次行动。胜利时再保住英雄至少一半耐久，档案也会记录你的指挥保全嘉奖。

column1: Nyx left engineering marks through these works. The gates are closing behind us, and Kerrigan has promised to watch our backs. We take the foundry together.
column2: 尼克斯在工厂中留下了工程标记。身后闸门正在合拢，凯里根承诺保护我们的后背。我们要一起夺下铸造厂。

column1: Destroy both production nodes to cancel their unfinished units. Scout around the warehouses, capture the industrial works with infantry, then hold through the final warned response.
column2: 摧毁两座生产节点，取消其未完工单位。绕仓库侦察，用步兵夺取工业区，再顶住最后一轮预警反扑。

column1: Armor and infantry need separate street approaches. Protect repair robots instead of letting them follow a chase; their service keeps this limited force in the fight.
column2: 装甲和步兵需要不同的街道进路。保护维修机器人，不要让它们跟随追击；维修能让有限兵力持续作战。

column1: Completion opens another approach to the finale. Bring the hero home with at least half the hull intact for the preservation commendation, and leave nobody behind.
column2: 完成行动将开启终章的另一条进路。让英雄以至少一半耐久归来，获得保全嘉奖，也不要落下任何同伴。

column1: The Meridian Spire is ahead. Nyx controls the doors, but people are still trapped below them. We need those controls intact before we can demand answers.
column2: 前方就是子午尖塔。尼克斯掌控着门禁，下面仍困着平民。要追问真相，必须先保住控制系统。

column1: Capture the forward deployment zone with infantry and hold it uncontested. Leave a guard there while the mixed strike force advances against the Helix headquarters.
column2: 用步兵夺取前沿部署区并稳定控制。在那里留下守军，再让混合突击部队进攻螺旋总部。

column1: Keep a route back to deployment. If the zone falls, recapture it before finishing the attack. Support earned at the foundry opens the northern ground passage.
column2: 保持返回部署区的路线。若区域失守，结束进攻前必须夺回。铸造厂赢得的支援会打开北侧地面通路。

column1: This ends only when our people can leave safely. Win with the hero at half hull or better to record the final preservation commendation in the archive.
column2: 只有人民能够安全离开，这一切才算结束。英雄保有至少一半耐久时获胜，档案将记录终章的保全嘉奖。

column1: The district reports perfect order. Its clinic is dark, its gates are sealed, and a detained family is waiting for permission to breathe. Restore the connection.
column2: 街区报告秩序完美。诊所却一片漆黑，城门封闭，一个被扣押的家庭仍在等待喘息的许可。重新接通供电。

column1: Reconnect the clinic substation, escort the families to medical shelter, and protect the district until the power stabilizes. Marked controls require infantry to secure them.
column2: 接通诊所变电站，护送家人抵达医疗避难所，并守住街区直到供电稳定。标记控制点需要步兵才能夺取。

column1: Use shielded units to absorb contact, then withdraw before hull damage accumulates. Open a safe corridor for civilians rather than following every retreating hostile signal.
column2: 用护盾单位承受接触，然后在机体损伤累积前撤退。为平民打开安全通道，不要追逐每个后撤的敌方信号。

column1: I will maintain the link beside you. Complete the operation with my hull at least half intact, and the archive preserves a commendation for controlled force.
column2: 我会在你身旁维持连接。行动结束时保住我至少一半机体耐久，档案将记下一次克制运用武力的嘉奖。

column1: This is the night Meridian closed. Two gate controls remain responsive, and Elias is calling from the far side. Procedure cannot decide what we do next.
column2: 这是子午城封锁之夜。两座城门控制站仍有回应，伊莱亚斯正在另一侧呼叫。规程无法替我们决定下一步。

column1: Secure both gate control positions and keep their links active. Divide your infantry coverage, support each group with shields, and protect the route between the controls.
column2: 夺取两座城门控制点，维持其连接。分配步兵覆盖，用护盾支援每组，并保护控制站之间的路线。

column1: A single concentrated force cannot guard two separated switches. Watch the approaches, rotate damaged units out of contact, and let their shields recover before returning.
column2: 一支过度集中的部队守不住两座分离开关。观察通路，让受损单位脱离接触，等护盾恢复后再返回。

column1: Keep the command link alive without sacrificing its operator. Victory with at least half my hull intact earns this operation preservation commendation in the archive.
column2: 让指挥连接保持在线，也不要牺牲操作者。胜利时保住我至少一半机体耐久，即可获得本次行动的保全嘉奖。

column1: Bastion guns cover the river, and every prediction assumes we will answer with equal force. We need the crossing, not another field of burning transports.
column2: 堡垒炮火覆盖河道，每个预测都认为我们会以同等武力回应。我们需要渡口，而非又一片燃烧的运输车残骸。

column1: Follow the marked objectives across the ford. Secure the necessary control positions before committing the main force, and keep an infantry screen beside the shield line.
column2: 沿标记目标穿越浅滩。主力投入前先夺取必要控制点，并在护盾战线旁保持步兵掩护。

column1: The river narrows every approach. Let the formation compress through the crossing, then spread out beyond it; coherent beams need sightlines, and damaged shields need room.
column2: 河道收窄了每条进路。让编队收拢穿过渡口，随后展开；相干光束需要射界，受损护盾需要撤退空间。

column1: Measure success by what survives the crossing. Complete the operation with my hull at least half intact to earn a preservation commendation and retain the record.
column2: 用安全渡河的生命衡量成功。行动结束时保住我至少一半机体耐久，获得保全嘉奖，并将结果留在档案中。

column1: The pruning order names people as corrupted branches. Their records are still connected to this network. Before anyone erases them, we will inspect the evidence ourselves.
column2: 修剪命令把人称为受污染的枝条。他们的记录仍连在网络中。任何人抹除之前，我们要亲自检查证据。

column1: Advance through the marked network objectives in sequence. Secure each control with infantry, protect the current link, and avoid leaving your support behind a sealed approach.
column2: 依次推进标记网络目标。用步兵夺取每个控制点，保护当前连接，不要让支援部队落在封闭通路后方。

column1: Use mobile shields and focused beams to isolate defenders. Withdraw depleted units together; preserving a trained force is more useful than accelerating a careless attack.
column2: 以机动护盾和聚焦光束隔离守军。让护盾耗尽的单位一起撤退；保住训练有素的部队，比莽撞加速进攻更有价值。

column1: There must be a witness when the order is questioned. Bring me through victory with at least half hull intact for the archive preservation commendation.
column2: 质疑这道命令时，必须有人作证。让我以至少一半机体耐久迎来胜利，档案就会记录保全嘉奖。

column1: The network calls severance a clean operation. Nothing about Meridian has been clean. We are going to cut the controlling signal while keeping its victims connected.
column2: 网络称切断是一次干净的行动。但子午城没有什么是干净的。我们要切断控制信号，同时维持受害者的连接。

column1: Follow the marked control chain and secure the final objective. Keep infantry available for capture work, and preserve a route for shielded support to rejoin you.
column2: 沿标记控制链推进，夺取最终目标。留出执行占领任务的步兵，并维持护盾支援返回主力的路线。

column1: Do not spend the entire force on one exposed advance. Rotate the front line, concentrate coherent fire, and let recovered shields carry the next engagement.
column2: 不要把全部兵力耗在一次暴露的推进上。轮换前线，集中相干火力，让恢复的护盾承担下一次交战。

column1: I intend to remain here when the signal falls silent. Finish with at least half my hull intact, and the archive will keep our preservation commendation.
column2: 信号沉默时，我仍要留在这里。结束时保住我至少一半机体耐久，档案将保存我们的保全嘉奖。

column1: They built a city above these drains and forgot who kept it running. Now the tunnels are our road home. Keep your engines quiet until we surface.
column2: 他们在排水道上建起城市，却忘了是谁维持运转。如今隧道就是回家的路。到地面之前，先压低引擎声。

column1: Move through the marked passages and complete each objective in order. Keep infantry ahead where the route narrows, and bring repair support through before rushing the next corner.
column2: 穿过标记通道，依次完成目标。道路收窄时让步兵在前；冲向下个拐角前，先让维修支援跟上。

column1: Our vehicles are fast, not invincible. Hit exposed defenders together, break contact when armor starts failing, and make the scrap we recover count for something.
column2: 我们的车辆很快，却并非无敌。一起打击暴露守军，装甲将毁时脱离接触，让回收的废料真正派上用场。

column1: And try bringing your pathfinder back in one piece. Victory with at least half my hull earns a preservation commendation; the scrapyard remembers careful drivers.
column2: 也尽量让你的探路者完整归来。胜利时保住我至少一半耐久，便可获得保全嘉奖；废料场记得谨慎的司机。

column1: Everybody wants this crossing. Nobody asked the people living beside it. We are taking a route through the noise and getting our own people across alive.
column2: 人人都想要这个渡口，却没人问过住在河边的人。我们要从混战中打开路线，让自己人活着过河。

column1: Secure the marked objectives around the ford and keep the crossing open. Send infantry to control positions while the rigs cover their advance from firm ground.
column2: 夺取浅滩周围的标记目标，保持渡口畅通。让步兵前往控制点，运输平台从坚实地面掩护推进。

column1: Spread out after each narrow crossing. A clump of fast trucks is still one easy artillery target; repair the wounded vehicles before you spend another batch.
column2: 每次穿过狭窄渡口后立即展开。快卡车挤成一团，依然只是炮兵的一个大目标；再投入一批前，先修好伤车。

column1: We win by bringing people home, including me. Finish with my hull at half strength or better for the preservation commendation and another story around the fire.
column2: 把人带回家才算赢，也包括我。结束时保住我至少一半耐久，拿下保全嘉奖，也给篝火边添个故事。

column1: That scrapyard looks like a graveyard to them. To us it is spare armor, working engines, and enough parts to keep the outpost breathing another week.
column2: 在他们眼里，那片废料场像墓地。对我们而言，它是备用装甲、可用引擎，以及让哨站再撑一周的零件。

column1: Reach the marked salvage objectives and protect the crews working around them. Keep infantry near each control point, and use your vehicles to screen the open approaches.
column2: 抵达标记回收目标，保护周围作业人员。让步兵靠近各控制点，用车辆掩护开阔进路。

column1: Do not charge past valuable wrecks while your armor burns. Recover what the route allows, repair between fights, and keep enough mobile force to leave safely.
column2: 装甲起火时，别冲过有价值的残骸。回收沿途可取的物资，交战间隙维修，并保留足够机动力量安全撤离。

column1: The best trophy is a crew that comes back. Victory with my hull at least half intact earns a preservation commendation for the outpost archive.
column2: 最好的战利品，是归来的车组。胜利时保住我至少一半耐久，就能在哨站档案中获得保全嘉奖。

column1: Wren has a reason for keeping this channel open. I want to hear it before somebody stronger decides silence is simpler. We go in together this time.
column2: 雷恩坚持保持这个频道，一定有理由。我想先听清楚，再让更强大的人决定沉默比较省事。这次我们一起进去。

column1: Follow the marked objectives and protect the people tied to the signal. Keep infantry ready for control points, and avoid outrunning your repair and escort support.
column2: 沿标记目标推进，保护与信号相关的人。让步兵随时准备夺取控制点，不要甩开维修与护送支援。

column1: Use the rigs to cover movement, not to block every narrow street. Take the space you need, repair what you can, and leave a way back.
column2: 让运输平台掩护移动，而非堵住每条窄街。夺取必要空间，修复能够修复的车辆，也给自己留条归路。

column1: I plan to hear the answer in person. Bring me through victory above half hull and claim the preservation commendation; we can argue about heroics afterward.
column2: 我打算亲耳听到答案。让我以超过一半耐久迎来胜利，拿下保全嘉奖；至于英雄壮举，回去再争论。

column1: Dust Rangers, Iron Wardens, every patched engine in this canyon: this is what a coalition looks like. Nobody gets to decide our future without hearing us.
column2: 尘土游骑兵、钢铁守卫，还有峡谷里的每台补丁引擎——这就是联盟。任何人决定我们的未来前，都必须听见我们的声音。

column1: Complete the marked final objectives while keeping the coalition force connected. Infantry secure the controls; armored rigs and repair crews keep their approach from closing behind them.
column2: 完成标记的最终目标，同时保持联盟部队联系。步兵夺取控制点，装甲平台和维修组确保身后通路不会被切断。

column1: Our strength is replacement and recovery, not throwing everything away. Focus fire, clear room for damaged vehicles, and rebuild the line before the next push.
column2: 我们的力量来自补充和回收，不是把一切扔掉。集中火力，为伤车腾出空间，在下一次推进前重整战线。

column1: Let us finish with a commander who can stand beside the others. Keep my hull at least half intact at victory for the final preservation commendation.
column2: 结束时，也要让指挥官能够站在同伴身旁。胜利时保住我至少一半耐久，拿下最后一枚保全嘉奖。
